title: Anti-Arab hate speech surged on social media during Israel’s election, report finds
summary_full: Digital monitors recorded 400% rise in posts attacking Arab Israelis, including Netanyahu’s disproven fraud allegations Anti-Arab hate speech surged on social media in Israel around the country’s general election last month, digital monitors have said, as politicians including Benjamin Netanyahu levelled disproven allegations against Arab Israeli parties of election fraud.A new report by the Israel-based Brandeis Institute and FakeReporter recorded a deluge of anti-Arab discourse across social media platforms such as X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok in the days surrounding Israel’s 27 October election.
